title: Free API credits
description: The paced free API credits inside limit.credits (DOCS-credits.md).

credits.description: Free API credits, worded and paced by the server. A new turn takes the credits while state is ready and spent_period_usd (the ledger's SDK cost times cost_factor, an estimate of the Console bill) plus a reserve per running credit turn is below cap_usd = week x monthly_usd / 4, never past it (over_cap); then it takes the plan, or waits when the plan is limited. route = what a new turn would take now (null: it waits). enabled = the global setting; state off, ready (key and SDK usable), exhausted (a billing error marked the credits out) or unavailable (key unusable or SDK venv missing); text says why. The period starts at period_start and week runs 1 to 4.
